_comment: Curated quotes for the Plume NTP. Each entry: {text, attribution}. All quotes are real, attributed, and on the themes of attention, stillness, time, and quiet. Picks are deterministic per local-day, so the same user sees the same quote all day. Sources are documented in quotes_sources.md. Add new quotes at the bottom of the array; do not reorder, or the daily picks will shift for users.

quotes.text: The faculty of voluntarily bringing back a wandering attention, over and over again, is the very root of judgment, character, and will.
Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity.
Whatever we put our attention on grows in our life.
Where attention goes, energy flows.
Be where you are; otherwise you will waste your time.
We are what we repeatedly pay attention to.
The present moment always will have been.
Nothing is so wearisome as the practice of having to hold in your attention by main force.
To do two things at once is to do neither.
When you walk, walk. When you sit, sit. Don't wobble.
The quieter you become, the more you can hear.
Realize deeply that the present moment is all you ever have.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
Be present in all things and thankful for all things.
Action is the antidote to despair.
You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
What you do every day matters more than what you do once in a while.
The successful warrior is the average person, with laser-like focus.
Calm mind brings inner strength and self-confidence.
Within you there is a stillness and a sanctuary to which you can retreat at any time.
Tension is who you think you should be. Relaxation is who you are.
Take rest; a field that has rested gives a bountiful crop.
Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.
It is a happy talent to know how to play.
The mind is not a vessel to be filled but a fire to be kindled.
We must not allow other people's limited perceptions to define us.
Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.
What we achieve inwardly will change outer reality.
He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.
The best way out is always through.
Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
Perfection is achieved when there is nothing left to take away.
Do not seek to follow in the footsteps of the wise; seek what they sought.
If you can't be quiet, you can't listen. If you can't listen, you can't learn.
The quieter the mind, the more powerful the will.
